open_questions: F-056: Why does escalate-unknown-shape have alpha=6 on a fresh substrate? SurrealDB persists data across container restarts — is this from prior successful executions, or from a prior test seeding Thompson scores directly?

F-051: Why does goal-host select harness-check-scenario for topology goals? Is goal-host calling recommend with 'goal' parameter instead of 'task_description'? Or is the template description matching 'harness' on semantic similarity to 'measure/check'?
F-031: Is the external API key's org intentionally different from organizations:substrate? If so, development-vessel templates should be marked public=true to be universally selectable.
F-049: Will the operator rebuild the container to activate 9c14b955 fixes? The RATE_LIMIT_ALLOWLIST_IPS fix is critical for a clean next startup without the 16-minute auth storm.

F-037/F-043: With 5 boredom executions completed but all showing 0 in Thompson counts — are Thompson updates being written at all? The harness-check-scenario trace has 0 total_executions suggesting updates are not being written back to the template.
